applicabilityBasis.summary: CASH is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for Phantom with 1:1 redemption through Bridge.

genius.notes: CASH's current product disclosures identify Bridge Building Inc. (BBI) as issuer and give NMLS #2450917. OCC Corporate Decision #1365, dated February 12, 2026, grants only preliminary conditional approval to organize Bridge National Trust Bank under Bridge Ventures LLC; the decision expressly withholds final authorization to commence business until preopening requirements are met. That conditional approval does not establish a CASH-specific PPSI approval or an issuer migration from BBI to the proposed bank, so issuerPathway remains unknown. The current CASH site states that Bridge will transition CASH to the GENIUS regime when obligations begin, supporting issuer-announced-intent without claiming an official token-specific approval. The 2026-10-01 ESMA EMT register lists Bridge Building S.A. for EURR, not CASH; this affiliate entry does not authorize the authored BBI-issued USD token. The issuer-published CASH dashboard is the current reserve disclosure, not an independent monthly attestation. The historical negative-evidence review below retains its original date and scope.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official PPSI application was located for CASH. The OCC conditional trust bank charter (CD-1365, Feb 2026) applies to a new bank entity under Bridge Ventures LLC, not to BBI (the actual CASH issuer). The PPSI application framework remains in proposed-rulemaking phase as of 2026-06-18.
